summary: In a Channel 14 interview Netanyahu said Iran had tried to murder one of his sons, citing the threat while defending security protection for his family.
notes: Freshness follow-up materially weakens any accountability theory based on the underlying threat being invented: on Aug. 29 the Shin Bet confirmed that Yair Netanyahu had been urgently returned from Miami because of a 'significant threat' to harm him. The agency did not confirm that Iran was responsible, so Netanyahu's Iran attribution remains unverified rather than established. Reports also said the matter had previously been under military censorship, but no official/legal finding surfaced that Netanyahu's disclosure itself was unlawful or improper. Do not canonicalize an adverse event absent that evidence.
